revisions.name: $uop_fast
revisions.reason: Review 20261127 --uop-opt 0x10000 V2c / 0x20000 C3 (opt-in, off unless the mask bit is set): four native ops are added to the uop engine's br_table, 143 XSWSAHF (FNSTSW AX and SAHF in one op: fpu_sw, AX and the raw flag record, $get_of read first) and 144-146 RECSUB/RECADD/RECAND (a flag record that derives its result or addend in the op). Each writes flag globals, fpu_sw or the AX register slot and advances $pc; none writes EIP, exits, calls back into the guest or touches a callback frame, guest stack, HWND, hook or message queue. Callback ownership remains pending.
